# tidyfundata

A collection of datasets containing functional data

## Installation

You can install the development version of tidyfundata from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("tidyfun/tidyfundata")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`dti`](https://tidyfun.github.io/tidyfundata/reference/dti.md) :
  Diffusion tensor imaging data
- [`running`](https://tidyfun.github.io/tidyfundata/reference/running.md)
  : Running data
